The full suite passes again: 517 of 517 tests. Two of the commits since v2.0.0 caused the 8 failures, and each needed a one-line fix in `src/`. I didn't touch any tests.

1. **`958d3ae` (thousands separators in `formatMoney`)**: the cents were padded on the wrong side (`padEnd` instead of `padStart`), so 5¢ showed as ".50" instead of ".05". That made $1.05 display as $1.50 and $0.01 as $0.10. Changed it back to `padStart` in `src/money.js`. The thousands separators still work.
2. **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork)**: it set `taxable = subtotal`, so tax was charged on the full amount before an order code like SPRING10 was taken off. It's now `taxable = subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`, which is how v2.0.0 calculated it. Line discounts, `lineDiscounts`, the `taxable` field and the empty-invoice check are unchanged.

The other three commits (currencies, US states, JSDoc) weren't involved. The fixes are not committed yet.
